text: The shack is the best breakfast place there is! Especially the Creve Coeur location. The girls that work during the week are always so upbeat and happy to see everyone that walks into the door. They provide awesome service every time and make you feel right at home. The managers are always walking around and making sure everyone is properly taken care of. You can tell the cooks make everything to order so the food is always hot and fresh!

Inviting causal atmosphere with seating for larger parties. The staff was super accommodating and made us feel welcome and at home.  The space is open and spacious and all staff wore masks the entire time. Craft cocktails are incredible! The Purple Rain substituting the Gin for Belvedere was AMAZING! The old fashions are equally as good and the Paloma was a light and refreshing cocktail. We ordering lots of food to share and I recommend you do the same! The Duck Fat Fries are INCREDIBLE!  Literally melt in your mouth and packed with savory flavors. The regular fries are also delicious. The Brussels sprouts are so flavorful and perfectly charred. The seafood dip, fried mushrooms, fried cheese, fried pickles, and Mac n cheese are all incredible and
Leave you wanting more. I mean, it's fried, you can't go wrong! 
Definitely a must try when down in the Gulch.

The food is fabulous! I got the meatloaf dinner.  It came with green beans, stewed tomatoes and mac&cheese.  All of it was yummy and the portions were generous.  My husband loved the broasted chicken and he is picky about fried chicken. I wish that their website had a notification that they don't start cooking until 3PM for dinner because I would have called sooner.  It would also be nice to see prices listed for warm sides.

In a dead empty store, it has taken 20+ minutes to get two orders of nachos made. And they still aren't made. The guy and the girl working are just fooling around. 22 minutes and counting. For nachos.

Placed a door dash order with them on a Sunday, ordered a 12  in turkey, 12 inch reuben, & 12 inch chicken bomb with 1 side of fries. When the delivery was dropped off, we were shorted half a sandwich, and the whole Reuben. My husband called to let them know, they offered a gift card or for us to come get it (defeats the purpose of doordash). When my husband got there, he asked if the meal was correct this time with the 12 in Reuben and 12 in chicken bomb, they said yes, so he left. Welp, got home and only have 2 6in subs instead of the 2 12 in he paid for. 1 screw up can be forgiven, but a second screwup in the replacement order, seriously? 
My 12 in turkey was good, but who wants surprises when it comes to delivery food. Mark this one off the list for reorders.

How does Capriotti's only have three stars?? It's a Delaware staple. I moved away a few years ago and it's still one of my must-haves whenever I come home for a visit. You really can't beat their turkey subs. 

I popped in today to pick up a few subs and the staff was friendly and quick. We were on our way in under 10 mins (and our order was correct and delicious). 

I saw some reviews say that this place is overpriced but I don't necessarily agree. The subs are so filling, I almost always have leftovers. I feel like I get my money's worth!

In terms of COVID precautions, all staff was wearing masks and there are signs telling customers that masks are required as well. The restrooms are closed and there's no in-house dining at this time.

We love Marzano! The food is fresh and delicious and service is always friendly. I highly recommend the crabacodo appetizer. It is half an avocado filled with crab meat and baked, so good! Remember to bring your own wine too!

I love Joes! Been coming here for years although I wouldn't consider myself a regular. Always stiff drinks, obviously. Sometimes the food can be a little blank and I wish they gave 4 slices of bacon instead of 2 with breakfast for how much more expensive it is than other places. Their short ribs are amazing! The 5 stars goes to the staff. Always above and beyond service which keeps us coming back.

It feels like this restaurant is still in the process of getting it together. The plates and cups were disposable, but the flatware and serving dishes weren't. The food, however, was delicious. This is not traditional Indian fare, but more Indian-fusion. The Chicken Tikka plate had a nice bite without being unreasonably spicy. The veggie sliders were pretty good as well. The samosas and mango lassi were the traditional favorites. I especially loved the red chutney. I will definitely be back!

My family and I love this place! We come here monthly for our sushi kick and have never had a bad experience. We always are able to get right in and are greeted by our server within moments with a warm smile and greeting. The sushi here is amazing you can't go wrong with anything, Trust me my family and I have ordered everything on their menu and always order a couple different things for our family of 5 to share each time we go. The portions our huge and you will leave full and happy! I highly recommend coming here it is worth the money and experience!!!

I've been eyeing this place and finally got my chance today! Due to COVID you sit outside at bistro tables on the sidewalk. We were very close to the street. It's how Lockwood is but they made it cute with planters and flowers. You order from table via app or walk up to a window. Everything is in to go containers. 
The menu looked fine. I felt a little underwhelmed honestly. But the food delivered! 
We got the strata - don't be fooled. This ain't your auntie's egg bake. The flavors!! So many of them. And wonderfully moist. Savory beyond belief. 
And we got the lemon ricotta pancakes! They were a nice mix of sweet but also savory undertones. We loved it all and can't wait to come back to try more. 
In a post COVID world the inside space looks really cool too.

Falafel Sandwich. 

Schug. 

Turkish Coffee Tahini Shake. 

Hot Sex.





- felt  very comfortable picking up food in virus times 
- ty

Saw all the great reviews only to be disappointed. The Tom Kha soup was too creamy, the coconut curries had too much salt and sugar, and the spicy basil contained too much oil. Additionally, the atmosphere of this establishment carries an air of cultural appropriation, and the results seem to be in the food sadly. If you want authentic Thai food there are other restaurants in St. Louis.

The food here is actually amazing, and sometimes the service is, but I can't really say that it's always great because every so often, you will have your order taken by someone who just can't listen... They frequently forget to even give you part of your order such as side items, or you won't get your salad until your food comes out (one time I did not get it at all!), or they'll bring you the wrong dressing and then blame it on the waitstaff when they entered it in wrong... A lot of little things like that which pile up. 

There was one incident that really upset me. We were served garlic rolls that were burned (and they do tend to burn them here pretty often, but when they are cooked right, they are really good) and when we asked for them to be replaced, we were told that they didn't have anymore! We were offered no replacement, refund, or anything. Then about 15-20 minutes later, we see another customer who came in AFTER that happened, being served garlic rolls, despite having been told that they were out of them. :\ There is really no reason you should be outright lying to customers, but ok.

Another thing I've seen them do is randomly close early for NO reason... Like not even on a holiday or anything, just on some completely random day, they will close two hours early sometimes. Why bother to even have business hours if you aren't going to stick to them? They also stop taking orders WAY before close, so I suggest getting here super early if you go. 

And they used to ha
Burgers are juicy. Large servings of onion rings. Mayo bar was awesome. Great place for burgers near the Regency.

I was really disappointed with the lack of professionalism at this establishment. It seemed like they didn't know how to properly attend to tables. Our food arrived very late, and overall the food was bland. An employee decided to block the sidewalk outside with a table. 3 stars is generous because the food wasn't terrible just not the best for what it was worth. I've had better brunches elsewhere

It's a sad day. I will no longer be able to go to one of my favorite restaurant's. 

During halftime of the Seahawk/Packer game, I ran up to Guero to get dinner. I always get a medium chicken burrito. I was shocked that the price went up, costing me $10 just for the burrito. Took it home with the usual condiments, and had a little feast.

During the night, I got violently ill. Then yesterday, had a high fever and horribly sick all day. I was unable to eat anything. Then last night again, violently ill in the middle of the night. Today I feel much better, and know this was food poisoning.

After decades of being a loyal customer, I can't take the chance of eating there again.
Very good place for Biryani and Dosa!! Starter was good too! Would definitely go ther
I love coming here ! Not sure what the bad ratings are about. The people working here are SO friendly and nice!!!

It's near where I live and only go  on Taco Tuesday and Throwback Thursday. Seems the worker turnover is high but food and service is always good. Having to pay extra for salsa seems petty imo but ofc I'm cheap that way.

Great meal options!  Does get crowded at times.  If you get there early, you can get basic eggs, bacon, or ham, hb, n toast, + coffee ("The 549"?)for less than $6! Specialties are more, but  really good.

Nice people watching seating outdoors. I ordered the small app nachos for my meal and they good. It was a lot of for a small size order.   I also ordered avocado fries, but they never came so I had to ask the waiter to take it off the bill.  My friend ordered the chips and salsa app. It came with 3 different salsa's. They were good, not amazing, not bad, but good.  She also ordered tacos, and I tried a bite.  NO thanks. Basic, pretty boring tacos.  They should change the name to Rocco's Nachos because those were WAY better.

I went here last Saturday with family and friends for my birthday. I made a rsvp on open table for 18 people. My husband called an hour before to confirm. We got there on time and did not get seated for 30 minutes. The restaurant wasn't even busy. When they finally sat us they made arrangement for 12 people and looked surprised when we said we needed more seating. The service was terrible. Refills were impossible. The complimentary bread we recieved after being there an hour was hard as a rock. The beers came out warm! I asked for hot sauce on 5 different occasions and never received it. We have been here so many times for so many different occasions and have never received such terrible food and service. I don't know if I will ever return. I can see why they were not busy at 8pm on a Saturday.

Would rate this establishment with a negative star if that was a option. Absolute disaster, was trying to spend copious amounts of cash and the service was terrible and 30 minutes after ordering we were told that a fixed meal was only being served tonight. DJ was a budget option and speakers must have been supplied by Walmart. Simply don't spend your time or money here.

Amazing beer, we enjoyed the Wheat and IPA selections. Something to be said about a gold and bronze GABF winning brewery!! Kicked up gourmet food options at a reasonable price (chicken sandwich and BBQ are delicious). Service was impeccable and the vibe inside is cool. They renovated an old High school gym, and kept some of the memorabilia. Cody, Bobby and Sean - you guys rock! We will be back for another visit soon.
This place is the best around to get tacos like this!! Great service and very well priced!! I love this place. All the tacos have great flavor! Can't wait to come back!

If I could give 0 stars I would. The food was ok the service was the worst we have ever dealt with. We ordered for takeout. A large pizza an antipasto salad and spaghetti with Italian sausage I asked for extra Italian dressing for the salad. The food came out to $55 which I have no problem paying if the food and service are worth it. We picked up the order got it back to the hotel and there are no plates no utensils nor napkins. If that's not bad enough they gave us ranch dressing instead of the Italian and only 2 small containers of it which wasn't enough for one person to have salad. When we called and asked to speak to a manager that's when things went to shit. If they had at least acknowledged and apologized we would have been ok but no the manager simply said oh ok. Ok what idiot he didn't even say sorry or offer any kind of explanation. He acted as if we were bothering him and we did something wrong. For the amount of money this place charges for mediocre at best food they need to get the right staff in there who actually give a shit about their customers.

Old Spaghetti Factory, Carmel Indiana
 My wife contacted the management to make arrangements to schedule a private room for a surprise 50th birthday party. She had four conversations about the date, number of attendees and special arrangements which was to have included a projector for a video presentation. We also visited the restaurant two weeks prior to our event to inspect the room and make sure that the reservation was on the calendar.
When our party arrived guests were told that there was no reservation. Consequently we ended up sharing the "private" room with other patrons and there was no projector as promised. We were very unhappy and disappointed. Also the waiter did a marginal job of attending to our needs. The food was very good but we were very dissatisfied. We have always enjoyed The Old Spaghetti Factory in numerous locations in the past. 

A staff member told us that we didn't have enough people to have the party room. However my wife told the manager that she talked to how many we expected. She also offered to call her if our number was lower. The manager said that wasn't necessary.

I am one angry dissatisfied customer!!!
I couldn't take my beer to my table. I think there should have been a sign to let me know instead of me ending up embarrassing my wife.

I hadn't been to Ocha Thai for quite some time but was out for lunch with an old coworker who needed a "Thai" fix. We chose Ocha for convenience to our locations. Although the ambiance hasn't changed it seemed somewhat tired. The food however was very very good. I had the Tom Yom seafood lunch special and he had the fried rice with beef. I couldn't stop raving about my soup and was too busy enjoying his food to stop and comment. Worth mentioning was that each of our entrees came with a cup of miso soup and a small lettuce and carrot salad dressed appropriately with a ginger dressing. My companion had his "Thai" fix and both of us were happily satiated all at a reasonable price.

I don't know if I have ever had a bad experience at a Sahm's-branded restaurant.   (Well there was that one time at one of their pizzerias, but I must not have been the only one because they rebranded it and it is amazing now.)

This is the way dining was in the 80s.   Sit-down service with a full menu.   Friendly service and large portions of delicious food.

The food is incredible, very flavorful and generous portions. I had the salmon which was very tender and well-seasoned with roasted potatoes and  peppers and onions.  My husband had the ribeye that was accompanied by cabbage and rice and beans.  We will definitely be back!

Very good shrimp tacos, however, I accidentally order the wrong order and tried to force myself to eat what I purchased and I couldn't, it just wasn't good. There were no accommodations despite the fact I didn't like it and had to order a new order. I paid twice and only ended up with one order of tacos. To further add insult to injury when I asked why do I have to pay for a whole order again if I didn't like what I ordered and was told that we were in a pandemic and that ppl are struggling to get by. This was said to me as if that wasn't the new normal these days, and as if I have extra money falling  from the sky. I wasn't offered my old tacos and the new ones but I was charged twice. Now if we were dining in I'm use to telling a restaurant that I didn't like my food and only bit a piece of one taco, they would take it back and make new ones without charging. Very annoyed.
Excellent and equally good service. They are a pretty busy spot so don't go expecting to be seated immediately. I recommend the French toast.
Clean and modern interior with a nice couple working the register, grill and even a few birds chirping over some middle eastern music in background! Asked for the chef's special!

came here after a recommendation from back home and WOW. My boyfriend is a raw oyster kinda guy, but our waiter and I convinced him to try the chargrilled, when in NOLA. We ordered a dozen chargrilled, seafood pasta which was cream based with shrimp and crab, and shrimp and Tasso grits.

Everything was phenomenal. But my god. Those oysters were the single best thing I think I've ever eaten. Word of advice, skip a meal and get a dozen charbroiled. You won't regret it.

Also, we came on a Friday night at 8 and had no wait!
Craving good Mexican food brought us here. The food is great. The enchiladas do not disappoint. I loooove the fresh flour tortillas. The service was also wonderful. We will be back!

I just wanted to add an update. Got takeout from them for the first time. We ordered chicken and rice. What we got was that, fortune cookies, an extra small side of white rice, the crunchy noodles, and sugar cookies and sauces. Not only is the food delicious, the atmosphere is amazing, the people are nice, but they truly go above and beyond for their customers. This is literally my favorite restaurant ever.
What a great selection of items!  Got my kids some snacks and picked myself up a few things as well.  Staff was friendly food was great.
Our waiter was nice & we came all the way from Central Florida to come here for my daughter birthday. The food is amazing looking & delicious. This is a great place
Best burger in town! Absolutely love it and the shakes are adorable too too yummy! Don't forget to add avocados in your burger

Stopped in late tonight for a quick app. I had loaded bake potatoes which were great. They had whole strips of bacon on them, which in my opinion is great, and lots of cheese. The food was delicious and one of the waiters there, Kyle(shout-out to a great worker who is leaving soon) always made sure our drinks were filled and we had everything we needed. Would recommend this cozy diner.

If you are a quantity over quality type person then this is the place for you. The quality of food and service has deteriorated year over year. This location is still wildly popular I have to assume based on prior reputation and the massive portions they provide.

Wegman's has recently begun their "Senior Hour" on Tuesday morning (ONLY) from 7:00-8:00 AM -- SOMETHING THAT WAS MUCH NEEDED TO PROTECT THE VULNERABLE SENIOR POPULATION, but not honored until a week ago. Unfortunately, when we tried this option at the Downingtown store in PA -- there was a long line and over 50% of the people that stood in this line were NOT seniors. When I had communicated with the customer service department the previous day, I was told that anyone who was not a senior would not be permitted to enter the store until 8:00 AM. This did NOT happen! 

Ironically, while people waited outside, everyone spaced themselves approximately 6 ft from the other person. But as soon as the Wegman's team opened the doors, everyone was allowed into the store at ONE time. There was NO social distancing -- and no regard for and respect for the elderly. This is unacceptable, Wegman's!  You should learn a lesson of how it SHOULD be done by visiting a neighborhood store like Giant or Whole Foods. They have a (one hour) senior slot in the AM EVERY day of the week  --- and they ADHERE to it! 

Many seniors were obviously upset. When I finally found the assistant manager and expressed my concern (there was no one in the customer service section), he snickered and thought it was funny -- which appalled me.  He then said he... "also had to take care of the people who had a compromised immune system, and... What was I -- a doctor?" in a snide, unprofessional manner. I asked him how ig
Great food, great service. Jon was our chef; never had better. Only negative would be the long wait to be seated (and I can see why it's so popular).

One of the top places on the Hill, so decided to come and try on a Saturday lunch (dine-in experience). They seem to put some measures in place like making sure the tables were 6 feet apart and ensuring that all employees wore masks. Other than that, it seemed like service as usual.

- Complimentary Bread - For a standalone Italian restaurant, the bread here is surprisingly good (I think it can be attributed to the sesame seeds on top). It was also warm and crispy when it came out!
- Toasted Ravioli - Despite the raves, I think this dish is just okay. Although the textures were fantastic, soft gushy filling with crispy outer edges, the taste was not super memorable. 
- Mostaccioli Al Forno - I really appreciate the portion sizes in the dish, definitely can be split into 2 meals... its a lot of pasta. I really liked the fact that there was broccoli because it soaked up all the delicious sauce. There was also a lot of crispy bacon in there which was greatly appreciated. Flavor is pretty good too but nothing out of the ordinary.

So why the 2 stars? There was a server who didn't wear his mask correctly which made me pretty uncomfortable to dine there. Would not recommend dining in right now for that reason.

I had a craving for a burger and heard they had a new Chef and a new menu. I ordered the BS burger and it did not disappoint . It was cooked perfect and it was one of the best burgers I ever had. I will certainly be back try something new

Vegans/Dairy Free beware. This restaurant puts dairy in things without informing their customers. We ordered Brussels sprout tacos to go only to find out that it had crema in it. On top of that, they put cheese on our guacamole. It was a horrible experience and when we called the restaurant, they basically blamed us for ordering that. First off, why didn't your menu indicate that your guac came with cheese? Also, the tacos presentation was absolutely horrible. It literally looked moI will never go back.

I brought my Mom and Nana here for Mother's Day brunch and we had such a lovely time. Their menu is about a page long for breakfast/lunch, but they have classics like French toast and Egg's Benny, so everyone in my party found something they liked. We got to sit up in the loft, which offered a spectacular view of the rest of the reclaimed space which was historically used as a pump house that fed water to most of the cities' fire hydrants (which is actually why Philadelphia never had a major fire like Chicago and other cities). 

Overall the food was good, but the space was amazing. Would be super cool for engagement photos, and I've read they do weddings as well.

Little diner with friendly service.

Sunday morning breakfast and the place was packed. Their breakfast coffee was surprisingly pretty good, and not a typical donut-house flavor. I had the Greek breakfast skillet and hubby had country fried steak. Both were decent, although I didn't get my hash browns darkened as requested. 

Our waitress was great, checked on us frequently and asked the right questions (ie: our OJ has pulp, is that ok? How are the hasbrowns?) I didn't tell her they weren't darkened, since they were served under a bed of tomatoes onions gyro and 2 eggs, they weren't going to be crispy no matter if they were darkened.

Place is small, old and divey, but clean and kept. Two breakfast entrees, coffee and an tall oj for $23. 

Magic answer is... no. Food was diner decent along with everything else but I typically don't like diners as the food is just average and not worth a return visit. But by the full parking lot, I can see how there's an appeal to a different crowd than myself.

Ate here for both lunch and dinner...both in the outside courtyard. A very pleasant atmosphere for dining. Lots of greenery, a bubbling fountain and string lights illuminating the space at night. The fire lamps helped keep the space warmer as well.    
    For lunch I got the shrimp and grits per the recommendation of Becky my waitress ( one of the best servers I had this week!) If you think you don't like grits, try them here. It'll change your mind. It did me! Also got the muffaletta sandwich. It was toasted, which surprised me but the warm meats, melted cheese and toasty bread was delicious.
     For dinner, I got the BBQ shrimp and the jambalaya pasta. Both very tasty. If forced to make a choice, I'd opt for lunch because the sunlit courtyard is more festive but either choice would be a winner! It loses one star due to the unisex bathroom door was not able to be locked, enabling someone to walk in on you if they didn't knock first. Recommended!

This is the best pizza place in Florida. Everything about this pizza is amazing from the sauce the cheese and the meat. They also have some really good appetizers. It's family friendly will come back.

I was in Clearwater Beach and we ate at Frenchy's Rockaway Café three times it is our favorite spot to people watch by the ocean 

Their menu is much better than the average bar foodStarting with their grouper sandwich everything we had nicely done  great food reasonable prices and an awesome staff

Absolutely fantastic! We came in for Thanksgiving dinner. This was our first time ever dining out for Thanksgiving as we typically are with family and friends. But my fiance and I came to NOLA for wedding venue hunting this past week and decided to stay and enjoy the holiday together as part of our trip. And wow, I honestly would opt to eat out again if it was as DELICIOUS and generous as the meal at Lula. It was a $50 all in prix fixe with 4 WOWZA courses. Since they were doing large batch cooking, this could have gone south fast where you're just trying to pump out a lot of food for the day. Quite the opposite. They clearly too great care in the menu preparation and the food really was star worthy. The flavors were off the charts. The starter seafood gumbo was creamy and savory with plenty of crab and crawfish. The salad with pecans, cranberries, and smoky poblano ranch was tastyAF. And the star course was cajun fried turkey breast and perfectly medium rare beef tenderloin. The family style sides were HUGE portions. Honestly, we had another full meal's worth to take home. Damn, what a meal! Ended things with blackberry cobbler and bread pudding. You can't go wrong with this meal. And I can only imagine what they do with the rest of their menu. The restaurant was stunning and gorgeous as well. It was a lovely backdrop for our intimate Thanksgiving! 

Oh and the GM was such a nice guy. He was giving us recommendations for places we should look into for venues locally. He took
Just more processed, fast food junk.  Yet another business plan hoping that you won't notice how corporate they really are.
They had loco moco/ spam and eggs  on the menu.. They give out big portion and unlimited toast bread..
They have a wine down Wednesday happy hour. I love wine on tap and it's 1/2 off on Wednesdays yay

Incredibly delicious food prepared by someone with an obvious passion for what he does. Such a unique and lovely spot in Kennett Square, although it's worth a drive from any of the surrounding burbs. Get the Senat Chicken or the "Bolognese" and you won't be disappointed. Wish we would have known there was an option for a tasting menu before placing our order, but that just gives us an excuse to return. Regardless, can't recommend enough.

Great place for a cool drink and a bite to eat while exploring Nashville. 
The Picnic Tap is located in the farmers market in downtown Nashville. They have a large selection of local beers on tap along with a limited food menu in a relaxed atmosphere.  The PT is sectioned off with seating for their customers, which makes one feel more relaxed while taking a break from the hustle of the market. If you're not sure what you'd like, the employees are knowledgeable and give you a recommendation. I also appreciated how they recommended other establishments/breweries to visit later in the day!

This place is amazing! Super long wine list, we chose a really great Malbec that went perfectly with everything. Our waiter recommended the Garlic Claws appetizer...best things ever. They were amazing, the sauce was so good they brought us out more bread so we didn't waste any. We split the alligator grillades and the duck for dinner and it was amazing. We were so happy with the food this was the only place in NOLA we ordered dessert from. Also the atmosphere was great and multiple people came to check on us which I appreciate.

Tough spot to find since its in suburban station but thank god I found it. It instantly became my favorite spot for Bao's (I've only tried it a handful of time to be fair) when they owner handed me a free sample of their chicken bao. The bottom is slightly crisped and fluffy everywhere else. It's not like other center city bao spots where the portion size is small. The pricing is great and they have specials as well with a drink. Highly recommend this place.

This place is amazing!!! I could drink the ketchup, which is tangy and homemade. Stopped through on our way home to Chicago. The restaurant smells delicious. The meat is smoked and wonderful. Our kids loved their sandwiches and sides of Mac and cheese. Really outstanding. Amazing bread. All the food was exceptional.

We had the rare opportunity to come here today since we don't live close by. The food and the entertainment were priceless. After 25 years of eating here we got to meet Mel in the flesh and he did not disappoint.  What a funny man!!! Really made my day. Glad to see the full parking lot, long lines and no available tables because that proves everyone already knows this is the best hotdog in town. I even got my daughter a shirt to get another generation hooked on Mel's. Hope it's here for years to come. A landmark in Tampa Bay.
Vegan? Wanting to have a variety of amazing food from pizza, burgers, raw dishes and smoothies? This is the best cafe for that! Stop in because it's my favorite!

I would have loved to give five stars, however this place is so inconsistent from coffee and food to staff. I have gone here about four times and every time was a different experience. I love how flexible they were with food, but no matter how good the food is, it's not worth it when the staff is unfriendly

Called to order take-out. Ordered two menu items for hubby. Then I learned the only thing I wanted to order is no longer on the menu. Since when? Order-Taker-Guy tried to convince me to pick something else--I repeatedly declined. Yes, I accepted the fact I would be making my own dinner (defeats the purpose of calling for takeout). When I asked how long until hubby could pick up HIS DINNER, Order-Taker-Guy taker DEMANDED my credit card number three times although I said EACH TIME hubby would pay in person. Order-Taker-Guy refused to hear me so I hung up. I called back and spoke to someone different to ensure Order-Taker-Guy got the point and cancelled hubby's order. I'll cook for both of us at home tonight. Since when do they require credit card numbers when an order is placed? We usually pay in person with good ole fashion ca$h. Yup -- we will NEVER order from Veekoo | Royersford EVER again. Buh-BYE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

My girlfriend and I ordered from this restaurant to be delivered on the night of June 15th. We ordered crab rangoons, a wanton soup, one pad thai (chicken), and another pad thai (pork). 

We ate the food for dinner and unfortunately the crab rangoons were terrible. The paste was so yellow that it looked like a custard, they were also slightly burnt and they tasted awful. The wonton soup was unsatisfactory and tasted a little off.

Finally, the pad thai was subpar and also tasted funny. We don't know if it was just the chefs that night but the food left us feeling ill and gassy when we went to bed. In the morning we were running to the bathroom so much that we were essentially taking turns hugging the toilet.

We've been there at least half a dozen times now (takeout, thanks to Covid), and the food has always been exceptional. In fact, Hubby always said he didn't really like Mediterranean food, but Istanbul changed that!  I'd been looking for some place in Tucson where they actually have the vertical grilling spits (rather than those boring "patties" that masquerade as authentic donar or gyro meat ), and this is the place! Portions are very generous, salad is wonderful and super fresh, and even the rice is amazingly tasty. Definitely one of our Go-To restaurants!!!

If your ever in the area and you have a chance to come to this restaurant I highly recommend you to come!

Wow what can I say about this place? This restaurant serves up some of the best Vietnamese food and pastries down in New Orleans! They are known for their king cake around the Mardi Gras time frame and have been voted one of the best in the area for it. The moon cakes they make and all the pastries are to die for! The banh mi here is really special due to the fact they bake their own bread. The  French baguette which is crispy on the outside and nice and airy in the center keeps you wanting to come back for more. They also sell baguettes seperate to buy for your own personal use. The lovely pickled daikon and carrots compliment the sandwiches very well along with the fresh green twigs of cilantro. The star of the show is the butter they use to layer the inside of the bread. Its so rich and creamy and very flavorful that you can definitely tell its made in house. The meats are very well seasoned and cooked to perfection! They offer a wide variety of meats such as meatballs, grilled pork, or your typical pork loaf. The sandwich artist always do a  great job preparing your sandwhich and the best thing about it is the lady's prepare it in front of your eyes.  This place can get pretty crowded so just prepare to wait if so and always remember patience is a virtue and great things happen to people who wait. 

Right next to the sandwich shop is the actual restaurant where they

Drove past here how many times to see couples in the restaurant windows smiling and eating. Hey, I want to be smiling and eating wonderful food, too!

Came in on a busy Friday night. Check in with the hostess. Go to the little upper floor and get a kerpowy good Margarita while you wait for your table. Very good, not the bottled syrupy stuff. I got the Cadillac.

Chips and salsa served right away. Great service. Enjoyed a tasty chicken mole plate. Tasty, not spicy. Enjoyed the medium spiced salsa. Not overly salty.

It's ok. I walked in expecting Arugula, Spinach & Kale but the base options of Lettuce or "Mixed Greens" we're sub par. 

The ingredients are on par with a Ruby Tuesday Salad Bar. So don't expect anything over the top. I disappointing dinner salad experience.
They used to make the most beautiful lemon chocolate doberge cakes and strawberry cheesecakes! We always got them growing up.

Cute spot owned by two sisters who live above the place. Friendly folks.  Food was fine if you're in the neighborhood, but not worth going out of your way for. If you're known for garlic shrimp and paella, shouldn't you use delicious, large shrimp instead of little ones?

I used to really like the Tamale Place but now they don't take phone orders anymore. Well they do take phone orders but you leave a recording and it is checked 24 hours in advance so that kind of sucks for a lunch order so anyway that's my complaint.

We went to Buno's for the first time today and it is now our favorite restaurant.  Can't wait to come back again and hit everything on the menu.

I had the Burnut burger, fries, fried pickles and strawberry shake.  Wife had an awesome omlet.  The food is outstanding, the menu is huge and the service is great. 

Thank you to our server this morning.  You were great!

This is our favorite place for take out. We have tried most things on the menu and continue to order our staples weekly because we like it so much. If you like a kick, go for their Thai Hot... it will kick your butt! Tangy tamarind Pad Thai medium for me, Yelow Curry Thai Hot for bae. Been ordering here for over a year now so here I finally am. I guess they're dipping into the pho biz too so I guess I have to go for lunch sometime soon. Enjoy!

Holy s*** 1st Visit  

Customer service 
Presentation & Food temp 

Cashier helped me with my order (BBQ NACHOS  w/ 3 sides ). I had to try a few items because I was told that everything here taste amazing. I'll tell you , they didn't disappoint me any. Nice music , clean, little to no wait , & happy smiling faces.  10's Across The Board.

Fine dining at its best.  Service is right on the mark of a fine dining restaurant.  While the price might seem like a lot, quantity of food is impressive. Most items are made in house.  The pasta is fresh and delicious.  The Calamari isn't breaded till ordered. Everything tasted fresh and very delicious.  The bar drinks were some of the best...especially the strawberry jalapeño margarita and the Smokey old fashioned.  Hope we get to come here again in the future.

Mama G's was great! There's an assortment of fresh baked goods - loads of bread, pretzels, croissants, etc.   staff was friendly and helpful. It was nice to sit and enjoy a cup of coffee at one of their in house tables. This is now my weekend coffee shop stop.
Second time here - so incredibly good! Fresh sushi, well priced and attentive service.

I've been here a few times and it's very good basic Persian food. Joojeh (chicken) is my favorite. My ex is Iranian and I learned to cook Persian food from his family so I'm picky. The sandwiches are great and sides are very good. One of the few places I've found douh (yogurt soda). My mom is veggie and enjoys it too as there are good veggie options.

Came in for lunch and had excellent customer service. Seated right away. The food came out quickly and was fresh. Signed up to receive texts and got free Redneck Egg Rolls which came with 6 pieces and really good dipping sauce. Also ordered a sandwich called "The Hog" and it came with a variety of meat on it and was fully loaded and good! Made it a big deal combo for $2.79 and got a side and a tea. The salad bar looked really good and had lots of variety to choose from. 
All together great value for the money, excellent food and great service!

Come on, just look at these cakes! SO cute and tasted devine!!

So the clown one was for a November birthday. Vanilla and cream filling.

The bow-wrapped cake for a December birthday. Chocolate and cream filling. 

Both exceeded expectation. Thank you Gallos Bakery!

Went to Rick's for the reason everyone goes to Rick's to sit on the patio. Food is always good. Erin was great. The margaritas were great. The weather was great the atmosphere was great but it's the patio at Rick's is it ever anything but great? Erin, if you're reading this I will be back to see you.

Went in for lunch after a walk at the marina. Made a reservation and was seated immediately. Sean was our server and he was in training. He was friendly attentive and did a great job. Zuppa as always is my favorite. Got some to go and it was ready when we were.

We love Giordano's deep dish pizza! This location had it all: good food, nice atmosphere and excellent service! The bruschetta appetizer was delicious! Ordered a large cheese deep dish pizza and the appetizer and spent about $40. Well worth it. Go if you haven't tried it!

Just waited 30minutes in line for food as they let numerous people by me because the lady in front of me ordered the whole menu. Got my food and waited another 10 minutes in line because of the Karen in front of me.

We have ordered from Trio's handful of times now and been happy each time. The square tomato pie is fantastic. Almost had the taste/flavor of a grandmas pie. The traditional round is great too. Very thin and crispy with a sweeter sauce. 

The wings are great as well. They are small and oven roasted. The spicy Cajun are our go to choice. They are a little pricey, but you can taste the difference. 

We have tried a few of the salads as well. They are not typical of pizza store salads. Very fresh lettuce, quality cheeses and the candies walnuts really have a restaurant feel to them. 

It has become our go to pizza place in the area. I live in Oreland and make the drive there without thinking twice about it. 

Also, all the employees that I have interacted with have been incredibly friendly and polite. It's sad that I have to say that, but so many places you order from do not understand how far a smile and saying thank you really goes.
Great Food, Great Service and Nice Atmosphere.  We sat outside and really enjoyed our meal.  Kind of small but that is the unique part of this place.  Can't wait to go again!

I came in on a Saturday night and Nick was our server. The restaurant was pretty busy but Nick had such great attention to detail. He is personable, he is caring, and he really treated us like we mattered. That is rare to find in a server now a days. Thank you Nick for being so great! This man deserves big thanks!! I will definitely request him every time I come back :)

Well to start off they have amazing customer  service. The girl behind the register was super sweet. Gave me great recommendations! As I went back to my car to grab my wallet, I came back in and mentioned how I really wanted to try a s'mores cookie but I didn't want to be bad. She came back and said oh you said it's your first time  right? Here's a s'mores cookie for you and another chocolate chip for who ever is waiting in the car!  After I got home the Santa rio wrap ended up having a little much of a kick for me... but that s'mores cookie is to die for ! Absolutely delishhhhh. I'll be back to try another option but I was definitely sold on the cookie !

THE WORST PLACE IN CLEARWATER, bar none!!!!  A waitress so clueless she was wondering why we had the nerve to ask for plates and forks to eat some crappy empanadas.  They took so long I figured they went to Cuba to get them, but they sucked.  Oh, and our meals came out at different times.  Mine actually never got to me.  They finally got it out but it looked lousy so I said forget it.  Please don't go there. Punish them for their idiocy.  Save your money and eat anywhere but there.
We usually go here for lunch. The gyro meat is a good appetizer and I really like the meatball sandwich

Great date night spot. Quaint little restaurant with plenty of outdoor seating. They do take reservations. Pace of the meal was perfect time to enjoy the wine before courses. I loved the stuffed pork bolognaise and the sausage Alfredo (new for me I have always had it with chicken). Both were excellent our server Anthony was great! Service overall was wonderful.

Excellent food and wait staff!
Excellent way to start off a relaxing weekend!
Champagne, Crabby Patty Eggs Benedict..all yum!!
Reasonable prices, great location and easy to find. 
Definitely recommend!!
The one by my house on the westbank is so good always quick and love the sandwiches, and the pizza is real good
The  chicken parmigiana sandwich makes for a great lunch.  Also their Baked Ziti is the best in the area!
It's great!! Staff, food, drinks! All of it! Ask for the homemade hot sauce you will not be disappointed your heartburn will not thank you!! Guacamole is creamy and fresh!!

Just spotted this place a few days ago while at another establishment.  Other yelp reviews spoke highly of it!  You will not be disappointed.  We both order the Jr Crazy Burrito.  Not sure who could eat the full size one!  Homemade hot sauce is to die for, you can see all the seeds from the red chili's Also loved the avocado cilantro sauce.  Come hungry, you will leave stuffed.
Delicious tacos the closest to the tacos I get in Mexico City that I have found here in the Tampa area

The service was ok! Our server Marlon was not really engaged and didn't car that nobody at our table liked the food . Everyone raves how good the food was and we should
Go through for our first visit because I'm such a foodie. We all ordered the lobster Marco and it was so bland and blah. No seasoning and very dry. I had to ask for Cajun seasoning on the side. The weekend. Even the char boiled oysters were dry

If you prefer subpar food...well this is the place for you! The food was horrible.  They even had the nerve to automatically add at 15% gratuity to my credit card. Their mistake...(that they informed me) the bill is in dispute.  I don't even want to pay for the little bit that I put to my lips

This was my first time and the food was delicious. A little pricey for a biscuit sandwich. I love the refillable iced coffee. It has a great atmosphere and good for a relaxing meal. I wish they offered more than fried chicken, for example fruit.

Absolutely amazing gumbo.   Best food I've had yet and we've been visiting here for a week.  My husband and I had the boudin balls app (fabulous) and the yumbo Mumbo gumbo.  The dish was rich and amazing and the way the shrimp was fried was superb.   Probably going back before we leave Sunday.

5-13-2020: They are still doing pick-up orders, and have a wonderful plexiglass set up to keep everything safe. We've ordered twice before, and we liked it. This time it was amazing good! We always order the General Tso Chicken extra spicy, and they really kicked it up. So delicious! Portions are great! Food barely fit into the containers. Definitely the new to-go spot.

We have driven by The Grill dozens of times but never stopped to eat until last Monday evening.  For us it was a 5-star experience. Admittedly, the place was not very busy (we were getting our first snow of the season), but I felt the service we received would be great whether they were busy or not.
The menu was very extensive, and because of that, we must go back and try some of the other offerings. On Monday, my wife had cheddar broccoli soup and chicken wings. I had a wedge salad and beef stroganoff.  Everything was promptly and courteously served, reasonably priced, and (most importantly) delicious. We will definitely be returning to The Grill.
Food was pretty good. The orange chicken had huge pieces of orange peel in it thought which made it a little hard to eat. But still delicious

Best service ever! Their fish bowl cocktail was delicious. We came in 30 mins before they closed because we didn't know tucson had a covid curview. We felt bad but they were happy to serve us. We were so grateful because we were very hungry at the time. The workers were super nice and get us what ever we needed. The portion was pretty small for the price of normal kbbq places but they were definitely a live saver hit the spot for what we needed that night.

I order the Full Rack of RIbs Dinner to go , get home the Ribs are tough as can be I mean I never had Ribs this tough to break  apart in my life , once I bite  into the Ribs it's was even worse so I immediately look to see if the Ribs had been thoroughly cook and from what I  can tell they hadn't .my guess they didn't prep the ribs & rush the ribs once I order them  which you can't do or you'll get the results I got tough hard to eat Ribs!!!!  Only reason I didn't give it a 1star was  because the Lady who gave me my food was pleasant & showed great customers service not knowing my dinner was about to be a disaster, but your cooks need a lesson on preparing ribs the correct way.

Enjoyed a hot chicken sandwich with added pepper jack cheese and a cocktail. The service from Emma was attentive, friendly and welcoming. It was clear to see a Emma cares about her guests, the brand and the experience- thank you. The shoe string fries were perfect and a very generous serving size. Well worth the money for a relaxing dining experience. Appreciate seeing they are doing what they can to keep people safe right now including all staff wearing face masks, amble hand sanitizers available and temperature checks before you can enter.

The pick up orders have gone downhill since the pandemic. My last two orders, I only received 10 fries and no condiments or napkins. I'm trying to support local businesses during COVID19, but this sort of service makes it difficult. My next burger and fries will be homemade.
By far my favorite place for breakfast burritos everyone is always super nice and have been coming here for years :)

Worst Vino Volo in the chain. I've been to many of them, and they tend to be a lovely way to pass the time when your flight is delayed. 

At this one, I sit down. Not at all busy. I couldn't get a bartenders' attention. They were too busy arguing about who has had to close more this month. When I showed my loyalty status that entitles me to the free amuse bouche and a $2 glass, no acknowledgement. I just got asked for my ID. And they never brought the amuse bouch. My wine was brought with no card telling me what I was drinking but it didn't really matter. It was so badly oxidized. It must have been opened for days. After 10 minutes of trying to flag down the bartender to swap it out, I gave up. I ordered a glass of something else, which was also oxidized. At this point I'm glad I wasn't given any food because I am not staying. 

Bad service, even worse wine, and TN's draconian 15% wine tax. Don't judge this chain on this location. It's an embarrassment to the franchise.

Love this place!!!  Awesome example of a great local bar & grill.  Staff is very friendly and food and drinks are amazing!  Love the dry rub and steaks are great; heck so are the burgers and buffalo chicken tacos too...eat local; you won't go wrong with anything here!
Their cakes and cookies are always amazing! I couldn't resist for this lovely Valentine's Day cupcake. I can't wait to share with my sweetheart Happy Valentine's Day

This was our first time trying combos and experiencing the "dig-in & get dirty" eating part. Our Combo A was mild with the Mr. & Mrs. Crab seasoning--delicious! Our server was attentive and tried to keep things organized with our large group. Thank goodness for kids meals!

Another hidden gem in downtown Reno, The Shore. Very nice decor and open kitchen so you can see what is going on. Nice menu, breakfast, lunch and dinner, full bar. Smaller menu which I like so you are not going thru pages and pages. Simple menu with what looks like yummy food. I stopped in at breakfast time, 1/2 hour shy of lunch. I didn't want breakfast so asked if I could get calamari, chef accommodated me , so glad he did. The calamari was excellent. Tasty breading, cooked perfectly. Comes with two sauces, lemon mint aioli and marinara. Both are great. I'm not a huge fan of marinara with my calamari but it was kinda spicy and I liked it. The lemon mint aioli was very tasty.   The service was great. View of river excellent. They serve my favorite Chardonnay here so that is a plus.   Prices are decent, not expensive in my opinion for what you get. Overall, I will be back because the calamari is excellent and there are things on the menu I can't wait to try.

This place nails it every time! My partner and I are vegan, and they label their menu really well (vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free) and have so many offerings! We've tried a variety of the vegan entrees, all are delicious (my favorite is the peanut eggplant dish that I can't pronounce), but my all-time favorite are the vegan dosas. Not sure how they would transport for takeout, but they're so delicious it's worth a try!!

I am overwhelmingly upset that I ever decided to choose Tito's for lunch. We called in an order and were told to come pick up in 30 minutes. My wife stood outside the restaurant for a very long time, door locked, while someone inside was cleaning with headphones on, ignoring her. We called the restaurant over 20 times and no response. We are now 1 hour of waiting and a 20 minute car trip down back at square one for lunch. Thanks Tito's. Jerks. Never order from this place.

WOW!!! A true hidden gem if you like Korean BBQ.  We ordered the beef bulgogi and spicy pork bulgogi both were very flavorful, fresh and tender.  Meal came with rice and an assortment of veggies.  Plenty of food for two with enough leftovers for a lunch.  Staff was very helpful.  Highly recommend.  Thanks for being open!

This was by far my favorite place to eat in New Orleans when I visited a year ago. I STILL think about the crawfish I got here (several times) on my trip. Service was friendly, prices reasonable, and the crawfish was unbelievably flavorful and fresh. Now I'll be grumpy all day cause I live in denver and not New Orleans. It was not touristy, not crazy busy, no outrageous wait. It's the perfect place to slurp an afternoon away.

All you can eat sushi is the best thing ever!  The staff and service was okay and they have pretty decent sushi too.  Just remember to eat everything or else they will charge for what remains uneaten.  One day I will get the sushi boats.

We had the fried chicken biscuit with jalapeno jelly, which was fantastic.  The jelly packed a nice kick to complement the chicken and biscuit. Also, the peppered bacon was thick and flavorful. The BLT was excellent with a great piece of break. Finally, the french toast was good and sweet. If you want to control the sweetness, just ask for the syrup on the side.

I've been wanting to try this place for while. I got even more excited to try it when I saw it was featured on Diners, Drive-ins and Dives. However, for a sandwich shop (I can't speak to it as a butchery) it's extremely overpriced. The food is also just "meh". The sandwiches are overdone, making them sloppy and hard to eat. While the sandwiches are a good size, it's out-priced for the neighborhood and there are far better sandwich shops in town that don't rob you for a sandwich and a drink. I couldn't believe the cashier when she told me the price and in fact had her repeat herself because I thought there was a mistake. Overall, not a good value and disorganized sandwiches. Sorry, but I won't be back.

What can I say - Root Down does brewing proud. Tremendous selection of beers, from complex lagers, to simple ales, and everything in between. The Mock, 1999 called, Hoppy Digital, Bine and the list goes on - each beer is unique and exceptional quality.

The facilities are very impressive, and the quality of the beer only validates this. With games for the kids, brews for the adults, and food for everyone from meat eaters to vegetarians, Root Down is solid. The ambiance is that of a brewery that keeps you coming back. 

Spacious, creative, clean - a go to establishment for drinking beer and eating food. Let the good times roll. Keep it up RD!!

Chazzz,
Pistol Pete

We went to BarTaco for the first time, and it was absolutely amazing. The style of service is genius, the precautions of safety they went above and beyond to put into place, the food and margaritas were just fantastic!! I dont usually write reviews, but we just enjoyed it so much, I had to write one! I can't wait to go to BarTaco again!!!

For a place called "word of beer" there wasn't much international options for beer. Although, there was an abundance of local hops and breweries available so I support that. Staff and employees were friendly and attentive. The outdoor area is pretty awesome as well.

Ordered a Cuban sandwich and some pastries to go, waited for the sandwich 15 mins which I don't mind the wait but the sandwich was cold. Overall the pastries were okay, nothing to rave about. I was highly disappointed about my cold Cuban sandwhich.

This Panera cannot seem to get it right, especially when it really matters. My friend is vegetarian and has TWICE (two different times) ordered a vegetarian menu item that then had meat when she opened it at home. First time was a noodle bowl ordered on the app that then had chicken, second time was a drive through order of an egg and cheese breakfast sandwich on ciabatta (menu item, 0 customization) that then had bacon on it (to make it worse the bread was a baguette, not ciabatta). 

It's a shame, but we're getting tired of wasting money.
kayla and Davis and Cole are the bomb! never have had better customer service! Highly recommend everyone to come 200%!
Another one of our favorites!  The Panang curry is delicious and huge. The Pad see ew is delicious!  They brought out a complimentary order of potstickers too!

I really enjoyed this Spanish tapas restaurant. They had a nice menu of cocktails in Spanish wines. The outdoor seating was on a nice patio with available heaters if necessary. The patio is also dog friendly so we brought along our little one. Food was tasty especially the cauliflower dish, Patatas Bravos, Gambas Al Ajillo and the cheesecake dessert!

Hands down the best seafood in Brandon. Great menu as well as a well priced prix fix dinner specials. My favorite is the shrimp and crab bites, shrimp and sea scallops on top of a bed of crab fried rice. Finish it off with the chef's unique version of carrot cake and you won't be disappointed!! Service is spot on as well!!!
Best wings!!!!! We ordered 2 lbs. which is 12 wings and the blue cheese burger. Both were super delicious! Curbside service was easy and fast.
If I could buy stock in any restaurant it would be this one. Try the miso spicy! The place is cool looking, the people are friendly, and the food is great!
Amazing service, great pizza, awesome managers. So happy with my trip to mellow mushroom.

I don't get to the B concourse in Tucson very often, so I thought I would try this place today. Had the the Arizona club which is a chicken breast with cheese bacon and so on. I was surprised, it was very tasty, the chicken was hot and steamy and the lettuce and tomato were cold just like you would want. 

I did not order fries or anything else so I cannot speak for anything else on the menu. However the chicken sandwich was great and I would definitely eat here again.

We went this weekend.  It is very unique.  We all enjoyed our meals.  The wine list is extensive.  You need to ask for the compete list, as there is a limited one that is provided with the menu.  We look forward to going back when we are back in town.

We stopped going here quite awhile ago because of the noise.  Then we heard the take out was good so we tried it for a special occasion.  Disgusting.  I ordered a NY Strip well done.   Attached is a photo of it.  About 1/3rd of the steak was a mass of fat on the left, and you can see on the right it is raw.  Son's was raw also.  Ruined a special event.  I have finally learned my lesson never to return.

Awaze Tibs were phenomenal, rich sauce, great vegetarian platter had great variety, Gomen was great , great Ethiopian restaurant that rivals the best. Doro Wat was great. Cabbage was great best in the Indianapolis area. But, the place is pricey. Great staff, great food for special occasions.  We go several times a year at least. Highly recommended, tough to find good Ethiopian in this area,

My boyfriend and I dined in for lunch and we were extremely impressed with the service from the min we walked in, to the moment that we left the restaurant. Sheila was our server and she was absolutely AMAZING!! Y'all the food... we had the seafood queso as apps and we shared the Fish house seafood platter . It was cooked to perfection and Sheila made sure it came out exactly when we were ready for our entree. We loved our experience so much that we talked to Mike the manager about hosting events there. As he was giving all of the contact info to book it, Sheila brought me my Saks purchase and umbrella I forgot about and left at the table. I highly recommend you spending your lunch or dinner here soon!! We can't wait to come back! Thank y'all for making our Saturday lunch so perfect!

I'm in Georgia and wish that I could support you.  Please know that you have the love from Woodstock Ga for supporting our police.  I would put this on my facebook page but am afraid my work folks would see it and take offense, isn't that awful?

Tiffin has a niche market in South Philly.  They have always delivered in a timely manner and better yet pickup is ready quickly.  There is never anyone in the South Philly location but they do a killer delivery and pickup service.  My go to is the garlic naan with any entree option.  I wish the food was a bit spicier but that is a personal preference.  It is plenty hot for others that I have ordered with.

I was so disappointed with my chicken curry, beef curry, and pineapple rice tonight. The flavors were very bland, ingredients seemed not fresh, curry watered down, and not spicy (ordered 4/5). It was such a big disappoint.  This has been my favorite Thai restaurant for year's, and recommend them to everyone who asks.  I see others have similar experience, so hopefully these reviews will alert management to make some immediate changes. Usually they have wonderful flavors and fresh ingredients. I hope COVID is not affecting the way they are preparing the food or buying their ingredients. I will wait a few months and try them 1 more time. If it's not better will not go back or recommend anymore.

Definitely one of my  favorite places for take out. The house lo mein is amazing as well as the lemon chicken. I have never eaten at the restaurant only ordered take out, but I can say the staff is always friendly. I would definitely recommend to try it, besides the prices are very reasonable.

I ordered the buffalo filet with garlic mash and carrots and it was outstanding. The only thing i disliked, is that the carrots were not cooked enough for my liking. But overall I would definitely go back for that filet!

Terrible. Just terrible.

Only 6 people seated for lunch and it takes 30 minutes to get a wedge salad and I asked for no onion and it is loaded with onions. Server acted like she could less she was there. I'm usually not this harsh but I can't find any positives about my experience.

Ordered two sandwiches. Corned beef on rye with swiss. Paid $2.00 more for extra lean.
Ordered a pastrami on rye with swiss paid $2.00 more for extra lean. Drove home to little and 52. Both sandwiches loaded with fat .threw one away and cleaned the other to half the size. Paid $37.00 for half a sandwich. Ripped off big time with cary out. Who would drive for 30 minutes to take them back then 30 minutes home again. I could have returned them if the restaurant had seating In side. I will never go back again and suggest others stay away. Disgrace to a corned beef on rye with swiss.

This was my favorite stop in NOLA. Make reservations a few days ahead of you want dinner at a popular time, but you will not regret planning ahead. The ambiance is fantastic and dimly lit. The cornbread was delicious and the fried oysters were delightful. I also had the Brussels sprout salad, satisfying, and the braised beef checks which I'll be dreaming about for years. This is now on my must list for NOLA.

They have the best fried red snapper and Peruvian fried rice In the city!!! Great portions and fairly priced. If you're in in the NE area (they have two locations) and are jonesing for some Spanish food, then this place is it!
